kind_of_no: mostly seasonal, no posted nightly rate or booking site (long-stay test 2)
why: Operator site icerockcampground.com (live, read 2026-11-22) calls it 'A Seasonal Campground'; its Sites page says 'Most of our campsites are reserved for seasonal campers, but we occasionally have openings for weekend, weekly, or nightly stays. Availability can vary, so give us a call to check for current openings', and sells seasonal sites with winter camper storage ('Add a deck ... your home away from home'). No rate of any kind on any page (sitemap's 10 pages read) and no booking engine: 'Call 605-261-5312 for availability'. A mostly-seasonal private park needs a posted nightly rate or a booking site that sells one night (curation doc long-stay test 2; an RV Life tier or camper report cannot stand in), so it fails.
name: IceRock Campground
flags: Not a duplicate: no DB entry named Ice Rock/IceRock; the only entry within 25 km of Webster is 5874 Webster City Campground & RV Park (in town, ~10 km south of this park at 13486 SD Hwy 25, two miles north of Waubay Lake).

Only rate found anywhere is Campendium's camper-reported 'Last Nightly Rate $35' (search-result snippet, undated; campendium.com refuses automated reads, so not opened). Camper rates may price an entry only when the operator has no web page, and test 2 needs the operator's own nightly rate anyway.

Nightly share unmeasured (no site count published; imagery not read since the skip does not depend on it). Google 4.9/13 per the lead, not re-checked. If the operator ever posts a nightly rate, re-vet: it would then need test 4 (1 site in 10 nightly) measured.
